```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```


```{r}
d <- read_tsv("ZM4.bed", col_names = c("chrm", "start", "end", "name", "value", "strand"))
d
```


```{r}
convert_to_start <- function(x){
    x %>% mutate(gene_start = if_else(strand == "+", start, end-1)) %>%
        mutate(gene_end = gene_start + 1)
}
```

```{r}
d %>% convert_to_start() %>% select(chrm, gene_start, gene_end, name, value, strand) %>% arrange(chrm, gene_start, gene_end) %>% 
    write_tsv("ZM4_gene_starts.bed", col_names = FALSE)
```
